title: Chloe Alpert
author: Chloe Alpert
description: Thoughts on AI, startups, and investing from an operator building at the intersection of software, services, and venture.
intro: I'm a founder and investor. My focus right now is a set of stealth projects at the intersection of finance and AI. I also run Ring Mint, a custom engagement ring concierge. I invest at seed and angel stage, and I write about operations, AI, and venture capital.

building.name: In stealth
building.blurb: Founder. Projects at the intersection of finance and AI. More soon.

building.name: Ring Mint
building.blurb: Founder. A custom engagement ring concierge. Every ring is designed from scratch in CAD and manufactured to order, with diamonds sourced against the client's brief from a global network of more than two million stones. No showroom, no held inventory.

previously.name: Hatcher+
previously.blurb: Head of Product. Led the company's AI work: 75+ machine learning models powering 12+ predictive scores for early-stage investing.

previously.name: Medinas Health
previously.blurb: Founder and CEO (YC S18). Reverse logistics for hospital capital equipment. Diverted ~50,000 lbs of waste from landfills.

previously.name: Mask Match
previously.blurb: Co-founder. Matched 821,000 masks from 6,200 donors to 7,300 frontline healthcare workers in the first three months of COVID-19.
